headline: Yuvraj #2 climbs to 43rd on ARC-AGI-2 with a 12.22 gain

sections.text: Yuvraj #2 gained 12.22 to reach 47.08 on the ARC-AGI-2 public board, moving from 92nd to 43rd in the past day.
The team is still well short of the gold line, which is held at 66.53 for the 16th gold place.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-2 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
